ties_at_peak.note: Under the old p99 ceiling several patches flattened to 1.0, so the 'hottest' pixel was chosen by array order. The new normalisation leaves a single unique maximum.

clipping.note: New normalisation puts exactly one patch at 1.0, by construction.

alignment.note: A mis-mapped grid would collapse IoU to chance, and would break on non-square frames first. It does not: the model sees a square 224x224 and the display stretches photo and heatmap by the same factors, so the linear mapping holds.

rgb_handling.note: Heatmap is written into an ImageData RGBA buffer and composited over the photo canvas. Channel order is RGBA throughout; there is no BGR path anywhere in the browser pipeline.
